servinfo.title: Water Pump / Generator Drive Belt Inspection

attention3.ptxt: Check water pump / generator drive belt when engine is cool.

s1.ptxt: Check water pump / generator drive belt (1) for crack, tear, deformation, wear or dirt. If any defect is found replace it.
Hoist vehicle and remove right front fender lining.
Check that slit (3) on water pump / generator drive belt auto tensioner (2) is within width “a” of protrusion (4).
If check result is not as specified, replace water pump / generator drive belt and recheck that the slit is within the width “a”.
If new water pump / generator drive belt is installed and the slit position is not as specified, replace water pump / generator drive belt auto tensioner.
